user_target: 综合改善至少2%，任何综合改善的中间产物都保留
selection: alphabetically first building of each of 11 uses in existing complete Hog2017 cohort, plus Byron; no metric-based choice
candidate: same model with residual factor0.5 only when lagged temperature outside training min/max; independent recalibration
ranking: previous composite weights; equal-weight building/fold macro average, all-row MAE and interval score, actual rejection and retained coverage shortfall
retention: keep bundle and prediction cache for each fold with improvement in at least one composite scenario; keep all metrics including regressions
target_pass: macro composite improvement>=0.02 in all three scenarios; explicitly report scenario-specific and per-building gains
caveats: local models across buildings: portability test, not frozen-source zero-shot transfer
development data, overlapping folds, not blind final test
